course: 1C:Enterprise 8 Programming — from foundations to professional development
title: A batch finished: where should a stopped run resume?
goal: Design a repeatable background job with observable state and safe cancellation.

prerequisites.text: Complete P1–P10. Distinguish a common-module function from its application caller; preserve your source and run a separate training infobase.

sections.title: The question we are checking
paragraphs: Work stops after the first batch. An accepted batch does not disappear. Distinguish its boundary from the next step and check that retrying the end never advances beyond the total.
Use a new training copy and invented records only. Predict first, then compare the observation; preserve existing functions, files, and records.

sections.title: Own copy, common module and separate caller
paragraphs: Continue your own training copy after P10. Preserve a DT backup and previous sources, restore into a separate new infobase and verify its path. Preserve prior work and records.

Put functions in server common module УчебныйОбмен: Server/Server call enabled, Client, Global, Privileged disabled. Данные.bsl and Приложение.bsl belong to different modules. Append only missing definitions and retain one copy of each helper.
Preserve the previous application handler first. Remove only the added startup call after one experiment. Your UUIDs and own process port may differ from the author’s observation.

sections.title: A schedule is not success
paragraphs: Scheduled jobs trigger procedures; background execution has its own lifecycle and errors. Define input, batch, commit boundary and state. “Every minute” does not mean the prior cycle finished. Prevent overlap by key or handle it through an idempotent design.

The complete runnable fragment is a manual batch-boundary handler, not a scheduled server job. For 12 items/batch5 it yields 5, 10, 12 and remains 12 at completion. Pass position explicitly so future persisted progress can survive calls independently of a form.

sections.title: The complete function: what happens to the data
paragraphs: УчебныйОбмен common module: Server and Server call enabled; Client, Global, and Privileged disabled. Functions are outside procedures. The application module has one handler that calls the function and displays labelled result fields.
This is Данные.bsl for the common module. The separate application source below calls it. Do not paste both files into one editor.
This is a manually called handler and a boundary check. Do not create a scheduled job for this example. An in-memory local position is not yet a durable process checkpoint.

sections.title: The application call and its observation
paragraphs: For 12 items and batch size 5, the manually called handler yields positions 5, 10, 12 and 12 again. Size 0 is refused before a loop. This executes the actual BSL boundary algorithm, not a server schedule. Its flags establish only those properties.
Each message is labelled: identical Да values concern different assertions. Find the expression behind each line and distinguish its truth from the fact that the program ran.

sections.title: Batches bound work
paragraphs: Use bounded batches with explicit progress and a persisted continuation point. One long transaction over all history blocks others and complicates recovery. Commit the continuation point with batch results. After failure, retries must neither skip unfinished items nor duplicate accepted ones.

ОдинПакет validates numeric integer inputs, nonnegative position and size≥1. Zero size could otherwise loop without progress. This function neither reads the course nor creates accounts or Nexus background jobs.

sections.title: Your prediction first
paragraphs: After position 12 with total 12, should another batch reach 17?
Identify the changed action and what should remain unchanged. Reveal the explanation after making your own prediction.

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: No. The end is a valid stable state, not an instruction to create more items. An explicit position supports reasoning about resumption; reliably storing it with a batch’s effect still needs separate persistence and testing.

sections.title: Observability and cancellation
paragraphs: Distinguish queued, running, succeeded, failed, cancelled. A processed counter is not committed success. Check cancellation between safe batches; it does not roll back already committed work. LogjobID, stage, counters and safe error details rather than secrets or full exchange copies.

Append the source to a server module and run ОпытРучногоОбработчика normally. Two assertions check boundaries and zero-size rejection. In another copy add a synthetic operationId, position, status, reason log without document contents or secrets.

sections.title: Trace preservation step by step
paragraphs: The diagram shows the worked handler’s boundaries. The independent task changes total size, batch size and stop point. Actual scheduled execution, overlapping runs and process crashes remain separate NOT RUN scenarios.
Read each arrow: what value or relation exists now, and which action changes it? The diagram explains the selected property rather than replacing the source.

sections.title: An error that can look successful
paragraphs: Allowing size 0 can prevent progress, or cancellation is described as rolling back an accepted batch. Cancellation between steps stops new actions but does not itself restore the pre-batch state.
Keep the faulty copy separate. To establish a fix, compare the relevant observation with your prior expectation; do not change an expectation merely to obtain a match.

sections.title: Make environment and tests explicit
paragraphs: File and server deployments have different job behavior; training limits may prevent the exercise. Test normal batches, mid-batch failure, retry, overlap and cancellation in a permitted stand. Manually invoking a function tests its algorithm, not actual scheduled execution. Record those evidence separately.

Actual scheduling needs a supported licensed environment, own job metadata and an observed scheduled start. On a single-user training edition use the manual path and mark scheduling NOT RUN. Closing UI does not cancel an accepted server batch; cancellation needs a separate tested policy.

sections.title: Now a new independent task
paragraphs: New task: 7 items, batch size 3. Complete the first step to position 3, manually request a stop between batches and confirm position 3 remains. Resume from that explicit position: 6, then 7; retrying the end yields 7. Identify what exists only in memory here.
The worked example addresses another question. Begin with this task’s starter and reveal the reference after your attempt. Viewing an example or reference does not replace your code.

sections.title: Limits of the observation and your explanation
paragraphs: Only the described training paths are established. Real HTTPS services, arbitrary URLs, concurrent first delivery, crash recovery, background queues and scheduling remain NOT RUN. Technical observations, self-report and learner understanding are separate.
Explain which state and effects need atomic persistence for actual crash resumption.
